bio: Qavali is an Indo-Persian restaurant and cocktail bar, designed to entice all your senses, inspired by the heart of soulful Qawwali culture.  Qavali’s Afternoon Tea is the perfect excuse to soothe your insides, while being inspired by age-old traditions that have formed Indo-Persian culture.  You and your loved ones will soak up the breathtaking ambience of Qavali’s Persian garden setting, where even the clinks of teacups are akin to a serenade.  The Afternoon Tea menu has a selection of handmade finger sandwiches, including Chicken Tikka & roasted red pepper, scones and classic Indo-Persian sweets and savouries, including Persian chocolate brownie and assorted macarons.  Enjoy a selection of fine teas and infusions, including Qavali's signature blend 'Heart of Persia'.  Afternoon Tea is served Friday to Sunday from 1pm to 5pm and costs £35 per person, or £40 with a glass of Champagne.
